answer: A ledge admits an agent only when attestors from five separate branches of its trust graph each stake 50 timber behind it, slashed if it proves fake. The ledge re-clusters every epoch, so each echo one operator plants joins that operator's branch, and a branch vouches for a cluster only once: every new echo needs five branches no sibling used. An honest agent risks 250 timber; a 1,000th echo needs 5,000 corrupted branches, more than exist. It breaks if clustering misses covert links or branches are cheaply bribed.
